description: Simulation results of grid-forming microgrid simulator is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Dain Kim. This dataset contains simulation results generated using the Grid-Forming Microgrid Simulator developed for the study “A Unified Agent-Based Simulation Framework for Comparative Frequency-Support Analysis of Grid-Forming Resources in Inverter-Dominated Microgrids.” The dataset includes time-domain results used to evaluate bus voltages, system frequency, power mismatch, total generation and load, individual power outputs of microturbines (MTs), photovoltaic ... Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 168604468 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
